core_obligations: Reduce the group isomorphism claim to the equality D = D_1 + D_2 of derivations and pass to stalks at a geometric point.
Use delta_i(I) subset K, D_i = delta_i - e, B = s(A) + I, and the annihilation of I^2 to pin down D_i by its restriction to I.
Expand the composition delta = delta_1 circ delta_2 through the henselian pullback C and the rule b_1 tensor b_2 |-> delta_2(t(delta_1(b_1))) delta_2(b_2).

Use the first-order expansion of c (zeta maps to zeta tensor 1 + 1 tensor zeta plus higher-order terms) to get D(zeta) = (delta_2 circ t)(D_1(zeta)) + D_2(zeta), then conclude with the conormal identity lemma.
proof_roadmap: Stalk-wise computation: pin down the derivations on the square-zero ideal, expand the composition through C, and kill the conjugation term by the conormal identity.
difficulty_reason: Four linked local-algebra steps, each with real content; the final addition hinges on the conormal-identity input.
